## Description

Delta method sampling variance-covariance matrices, standard errors,
test statistics, and confidence intervals
for functions of parameters in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
using a numerical Jacobian.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `deltaMethod` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/deltaMethod) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/deltaMethod")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "deltaMethod")
```

A logistic regression of `vs` on `wt` and `disp`.

```{r}
object <- stats::glm(
  formula = vs ~ wt + disp,
  family = "binomial",
  data = mtcars
)
```

`Delta()` takes the estimates, their sampling variance-covariance matrix,
and an R function of the estimates.
Here, the odds ratios of `wt` and `disp`.

```{r}
func <- function(x) {
  y <- exp(x = x)
  names(x = y) <- paste0("exp", "(", names(x = x), ")")
  y[-1]
}
out <- Delta(
  coef = stats::coef(object = object),
  vcov = stats::vcov(object = object),
  func = func,
  alpha = 0.05
)
out
```

`DeltaGeneric()` takes the fitted model
and character strings that define functions of its coefficients.

```{r}
out <- DeltaGeneric(
  object = object,
  def = list("exp(wt)", "exp(disp)"),
  alpha = 0.05
)
summary(object = out)
stats::confint(object = out, level = 0.95)
stats::vcov(object = out)
```
